purpose: Source verification for the A0 validation ladder (work-order task T01). No value here has been used to build geometry yet.

evidence_labels.VERIFIED_FROM_SOURCE: read directly from the authoritative document retrieved and hashed below
evidence_labels.VERIFIED_FROM_ARCHIVE: read from a timestamped Internet Archive snapshot because the authoritative live URL no longer serves the page; weaker than VERIFIED_FROM_SOURCE because the snapshot may not match the current authoritative version
evidence_labels.DERIVED_FROM_SOURCE: computed from verified values; the derivation is stated
evidence_labels.ASSUMED_FOR_MESH_ONLY: not in the source; chosen to allow meshing and declared as an assumption
evidence_labels.MISSING: required and not obtained; blocks the dependent step

a0_1_parameters.locator: TMR 2DN00 case page: 'essentially incompressible conditions (the recommendation here is to run M = 0.15 in compressible CFD codes)'
TMR 2DN00: 'The Reynolds number per chord is Re = 6 million.'
TMR 2DN00: 'Boundary layers should be fully turbulent over most of the airfoil.'
TMR 2DN00 quantities of interest: 'Surface pressure coefficient (Cp) vs. x/c (for alpha = 0, 10, 15)'

a0_1_parameters.note: No experimental skin-friction data exist for this case; Cf is computed but cannot be validated.

a0_1_parameters.locator: TMR 2DN00: farfield in the provided grids is 'almost 500 chords away'
a0_1_parameters.note: If a nearer farfield is used, the point-vortex correction of Thomas and Salas (AIAA J 24(7):1074-1080, 1986) is required.

NOT the standard blunt-trailing-edge NACA 0012. Built by extending the exact formula to x=1.008930411365 (sharp TE) then scaling by that factor. Max thickness 11.894 percent of the scaled chord. The prior case file said only 'NACA 0012 (analytic section)', which would have produced the wrong geometry.

a0_1_parameters.locator: Linked from the TMR case page; the link target is behind the dead live domain and was not retrieved
a0_1_parameters.note: Not required: the revised analytic formula above is sufficient to generate the section.

a0_1_parameters.locator: TMR grid page redirects like every other TMR path; multi-megabyte grid archives are not in the retrieved snapshot
a0_1_parameters.note: Consequence: the TMR grid family cannot be used. A scripted C-grid family must be generated instead, and results are therefore NOT directly comparable to TMR's published per-grid CFD values. This changes work-order task T04.

a0_1_parameters.value: Ladson, C. L., NASA TM 4074, October 1988 (tripped)
a0_1_parameters.locator: TMR 2DN00: the Ladson tripped data 'appear to be the most appropriate of these data sets for comparison with fully turbulent CFD forces at Re=6 million'; NTRS 19880019495
a0_1_parameters.note: Use for CL and CD comparison.

a0_1_parameters.value: Gregory, N. and O'Reilly, C. L., R&M 3726, January 1970 (tripped, Re = 3 million)
a0_1_parameters.locator: TMR 2DN00: Gregory and O'Reilly Cp data 'appear to be better resolved' than Ladson TM 100526
a0_1_parameters.note: Re mismatch (3e6 vs 6e6) must be carried as a stated bias when comparing Cp.

a0_1_parameters.value: Abbott and von Doenhoff (1959) were not tripped
a0_1_parameters.locator: TMR 2DN00: 'experimental drag coefficient levels are greatly affected by tripping the boundary layer at Reynolds numbers in this range. For comparing with fully turbulent CFD drag results, tripped experimental data are more appropriate than untripped.'
a0_1_parameters.note: Gating drag against untripped data would be a source-contradicted comparison.

a0_1_parameters.locator: TMR 2DN00, citing McCroskey: 'tripped CD,0 at Re=3 million is about 10% higher than tripped CD,0 at Re=6 million'
a0_1_parameters.note: Bounds the penalty for using a Re=3e6 dataset for drag.

a0_2_parameters.locator: TM-81232 p.2: 'The rotor employed two cantilever-mounted, manually adjustable blades'
TM-81232 p.2: 'These blades used an NACA 0012 profile and were untwisted and untapered.'
TM-81232 p.2: 'An aspect ratio of 6 was chosen in order to maximize Reynolds Number and available instrumentation space.'
TM-81232 p.2: 'two cantilever-mounted, manually adjustable blades with half degree precone'
a0_2_parameters.note: Omitted from the earlier plan; it is a real geometric feature of the test article.

a0_2_parameters.locator: Figure 1 dimension text in the scanned report is OCR-ambiguous ('C\ 7.5ft'); 1.143 m = 3.75 ft is the value consistent with aspect ratio 6 and a 7.5 in chord
a0_2_parameters.note: MUST be confirmed visually against figure 1 of the PDF before meshing. Nondimensional comparisons (CT, Cp) do not depend on it; blade Reynolds number does.

a0_2_parameters.locator: Derived: chord = radius / aspect ratio = 1.143 / 6 = 0.1905 m (7.5 in)
TM-81232 figures 3, 4, 5: 'collective pitch 5 deg / 8 deg / 12 deg'
TM-81232 figure 4 and the CT series at 8 deg collective

a0_2_parameters.note: This is the A0.2 force comparison datum.
Not in scope for an incompressible solver.

a0_2_parameters.locator: Derived from the reported pair (1750 rpm, Mtip 0.612): Mtip scales linearly with rpm, so Mtip(1250) = 0.612 * 1250/1750 = 0.437
a0_2_parameters.note: CONSEQUENCE: the A0.2 baseline is NOT incompressible. A Prandtl-Glauert factor 1/sqrt(1-0.437^2) = 1.11 implies roughly an 11 percent compressibility influence on outboard sectional Cp. Declared before running; see the acceptance record.

a0_2_parameters.locator: TM-81232 figure annotations 'r/R = 0.50', '0.68', '0.80', '0.96' (one figure also reports 0.966)
a0_2_parameters.note: Three radial locations per blade, five measurement locations total (TM-81232 p.2).

a0_2_parameters.value: 60 pressure tubes per blade into three 4888 Scanivalves with Statham PA 856-15 transducers

a0_2_parameters.locator: Not located in the retrieved text during T01
a0_2_parameters.note: Needed for the validation uncertainty U_D of A0.2. Until found, U_D is unquantified and the A0.2 verdict can only be reported at a stated-numerical-uncertainty level, not a full ASME V&V 20 validation level.
Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for the selected incompressible solver.
